nodes.label: General Scales Unlock AI Evaluation with Explanatory and Predictive Power
nodes.author: Lexin Zhou et al.
nodes.rationale: Introduces 18 general scales (DeLeAn rubrics) for AI evaluation with demand and ability profiles, enabling construct-valid benchmarking and instance-level performance prediction.

nodes.label: DeLeAn Rubrics v1.0
nodes.rationale: 18 demand-level-annotation rubrics capturing cognitive and intellectual demands; applied to task instances on 0-5+ scale for construct-valid AI evaluation.

nodes.label: ADeLe Battery v1.0
nodes.rationale: 16,108 annotated instances from 20 benchmarks across 63 tasks; 289,944 annotations on 18 general scales; enables demand profile analysis and construct validity assessment.

nodes.label: Elemental Capabilities (11 dimensions)
nodes.rationale: General cognitive capabilities including verbal comprehension, logical reasoning, metacognition; not derived from other capabilities.

nodes.label: Knowledge Capabilities (5 dimensions)
nodes.rationale: Domain expertise in natural sciences, formal sciences, applied sciences, social sciences, and customary knowledge; calibrated to educational levels.

nodes.label: Extraneous Dimensions (3 dimensions)
nodes.rationale: Atypicality (contamination), Volume (amalgamation), Unguessability (funnelling); account for difficulty factors independent of cognitive demands.

nodes.label: Demand Profile
nodes.rationale: 18-dimensional histogram of demand levels for a benchmark; reveals sensitivity (measures claimed dimensions) and specificity (does not measure extraneous dimensions).

nodes.label: Ability Profile
nodes.rationale: 18-dimensional vector of ability estimates for an AI system; commensurate with demand scales; independent of benchmark population.

nodes.label: Subject Characteristic Curve
nodes.rationale: Logistic fit showing model success probability as function of demand level for each dimension; summarized into ability estimate via area under curve.

nodes.label: Demand-Based Assessor
nodes.rationale: Random forest classifier using 19-dimensional demand annotation vector to predict instance-level success; superior predictive power especially out-of-distribution.

nodes.label: Construct Validity in AI Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Benchmarks should measure what they claim to measure (sensitivity) and not measure extraneous dimensions (specificity); most common benchmarks lack both.

nodes.label: Ratio Scale Measurement
nodes.rationale: Demands and abilities defined on ratio scales (0, ∞) with absolute zero; enables meaningful ratios and commensurate comparisons across dimensions.

nodes.label: Inter-Rater Agreement Analysis
nodes.rationale: rWG index 0.70-0.91 for humans; 0.75-0.94 for GPT-4o vs. Delphi consensus; validates rubric clarity and human interpretability.

nodes.label: In-Distribution Predictive Power
nodes.rationale: Demand-based assessor achieves AUROC ~0.84 and ECE ~0.01; supports internal validity of methodology.

nodes.label: Out-of-Distribution Predictive Power
nodes.rationale: Task OOD: AUROC 0.81; Benchmark OOD: AUROC 0.75; demand-based assessor outperforms embedding and fine-tuned baselines; robust to distribution shift.

nodes.label: Scaling Laws for Abilities
nodes.rationale: Knowledge abilities scale with model size; reasoning abilities boosted by chain-of-thought; diminishing returns observed for largest models.

nodes.label: Reasoning Models Distinction
nodes.rationale: OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1-Distilled show distinct improvements in quantitative/logical reasoning and mind modelling; characteristic curves clearly distinguish from non-reasoning models.

nodes.label: Benchmark Contamination and Saturation
nodes.rationale: Many benchmarks saturated (>75% accuracy); contamination (high atypicality), amalgamation (high volume), funnelling (low unguessability) identified as confounds.

nodes.label: Future Work Extensions
nodes.rationale: Extend rubrics to multimodal systems, robotics, safety/fairness dimensions; improve level 5+ items; increase predictive power with purer benchmarks.

nodes.label: Collaborative Evaluation Platform
nodes.rationale: Open-source platform for customizing scales, extending rubrics, and applying methodology; enables community-driven AI evaluation standardization.

nodes.label: ADeLe Battery - AI Evaluation Framework
nodes.author: Hernández-Orallo, J. et al.
nodes.rationale: Non-populational measurement paradigm for evaluating AI capabilities independent of other systems; absolute scale enables forward-looking extensibility and backward compatibility

nodes.label: Demand Scales & DeLeAn Rubrics
nodes.author: Hernández-Orallo, J. et al.
nodes.rationale: 18 demand dimensions (11 elemental, 5 knowledge, 2 extraneous) plus unguessability metric; enables multidimensional task characterization independent of subject population

nodes.label: Ability Estimation via Characteristic Curves
nodes.author: Hernández-Orallo, J. et al.
nodes.rationale: Logistic function fitting to estimate ability as level at which success probability = 0.5; invariant to task distribution changes, unlike performance metrics

nodes.label: Item Response Theory (IRT) Foundations
nodes.author: Thurstone, L. L.; Fischer, G. H.
nodes.rationale: Inspired by IRT and linear logistic test model but differs by using single-LLM information only, avoiding populational dependencies that plague traditional IRT

nodes.label: AUROC and ECE Evaluation Metrics
nodes.rationale: Capture discrimination and calibration aspects of predictive power; commensurate for comparing distinct assessor-subject pairs

nodes.label: Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Statistical Test
nodes.rationale: Applied to win-loss outcomes across 10 folds with 10 repetitions for statistical significance testing between demand-based and baseline assessors

nodes.label: System Process Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Applies to new AI systems: run on ADeLe battery, plot characteristic curves, summarize ability profile with radial plot

nodes.label: Task Process Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Extends methodology: use DeLeAn rubrics to obtain demand profiles for new tasks/benchmarks, enabling continuous updates while maintaining measurement space consistency

nodes.label: Dual Profiling of Tasks and Systems
nodes.rationale: Reconciles contradictory evaluation outcomes by explaining benchmark discrepancies through demand profile differences

nodes.label: Non-Populational Measurement Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Measurement independent of population composition; enables forward compatibility as new systems emerge; contrasts with IRT and factor analysis
